slot.brief: Predict hybridisation/shape of PCl5-like phosphorus halide or its hydrolysis product; simple structure recall.

stem: In phosphorus(V) oxide (P4O10), the geometry around each phosphorus atom is

verdicts.working: Each phosphorus atom is bonded to four oxygen atoms, giving a tetrahedral arrangement.

working:
Each P atom in P4O10 forms four sigma bonds: three to bridging O atoms (P-O-P) and one to a terminal O atom (P=O). There is no lone pair on P. Steric number = 4, so the arrangement of electron pairs is tetrahedral. Hence the geometry around each P is tetrahedral.
